author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: A Microsoft 365 outage stopped a hotel’s email chlorine alert in Germany, and 15 guests were poisoned. A hotel in Germany had a maintenance safety system for its sauna area. If the chlorine level got too high, the system emailed the operators. When Microsoft’s cloud services failed, those emails couldn’t go out, the chlorine rose, […]
title: The Microsoft Outage Left 15 Hotel Guests Poisoned by Chlorine

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Italy fines Meta €805 million over Facebook’s access to Android users’ photo galleries without specific consent, affecting around 20 million people. Italy’s data protection authority, the Garante, has fined Meta Platforms Ireland Limited €805 million. The reason is that the Facebook app for Android reached into photos, videos, and their metadata on Italian users’ phones […]
title: Meta Fined €805 Million in Italy Over Facebook’s Default Photo Gallery Access
